source.source_name: Enhetsregisteret — Central Coordinating Register for Legal Entities (entities)
source.attribution: Inneholder data under Norsk lisens for offentlige data (NLOD) tilgjengeliggjort av Brønnøysundregistrene.

headers_required.name: Accept
headers_required.note: for JSON.gz bulk; use .../lastned/csv for CSV.gz

transport.record_path: $ (gzip JSON is a top-level array of entities; CSV is one row per entity with dot-notation headers)
transport.total_results_path: page.totalElements (on the /enheter search endpoint, not the bulk file)

pagination.note: Bulk file is preferred for full load. The search API paginates with page/size (HAL _links) but is slower for full crawls.

incremental_feed.note: Daily delta feed of changed org numbers; re-fetch only changed entities.

transport.rate_limit: unknown (not published); prefer bulk + delta feed over page crawling

parsing.notes: JSON bulk preserves nested objects/arrays + kapital + aktivitet; CSV flattens to dot-notation columns and adds *Dato status dates, epostadresse, and foreign-entity columns but drops kapital/aktivitet. Choose JSON bulk for richest data. CSV header casing differs slightly from JSON keys.

mapping_rules.status: Derive from booleans: konkurs -> bankrupt; underTvangsavviklingEllerTvangsopplosning -> compulsory_liquidation; underAvvikling -> liquidation; else active.

fixture_requirements: representative active AS/ASA with kapital + naeringskode1..3 + forretningsadresse + postadresse
entity missing optional fields (no website, no employees, no kapital)
dissolved/bankrupt entity (konkurs=true with konkursdato in CSV)
malformed individual record / truncated gzip stream

live_test_plan.smoke: GET /enheter?size=5 and one /enheter/{orgnr}; assert page.totalElements > 1,000,000 and required fields present.
live_test_plan.full: Download .../enheter/lastned (JSON.gz ~197MB), stream-decode, count records; gate behind explicit env flag. Then exercise /oppdateringer/enheter delta feed.
